summary: The recorded base reproduces the stale batch_is_full early return. At the exact candidate, both the candidate regression suite and independent adversarial checks pass: stale capacity is reconsidered, genuine zero capacity safely re-latches fullness, and an active chunk continuation still bypasses the ordinary slot gate. No functional counterexample was found.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction on base: all three candidate regression/boundary tests failed because stale fullness returned before current admission logic.
Independent base check: the starvation assertion failed, while true-zero-capacity and chunk-continuation safety cases passed.
Exact candidate focused suite: 6 passed, including its stale-state and capacity boundary regressions.
Exact candidate independent adversarial suite: 3 passed for stale hint reconsideration, real zero capacity, and chunk-continuation bypass.
Candidate artifact hygiene: trailing whitespace exists in captured pytest logs, contradicting the candidate report's diff-check claim; no scheduler source whitespace error was reported.

gpu_evidence: Candidate-retained run on one gfx950 used a qualified tiny random Llama and showed a waiting request admitted while earlier requests remained active. This review also confirmed ROCm 7.2, AMD Instinct MI355X, and gfx950 availability, but did not rerun serving.
remaining_limitations: No native source changed, so no rebuild was applicable. Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 weights and its hybrid GDN/linear-attention and mamba-state behavior, NEXTN speculative decoding, FP8 KV cache, Docker/WSL2 environment, semantic accuracy, and the multi-minute production workload were unavailable. The retained tiny-Llama GPU trace validates only generic transport, scheduling, and engine execution, not those architecture-specific dimensions.
